question.title: Ferry Manifest Tally
question.content:
A ferry office keeps a table manifest. Each row is [vehicle, destination], one row per vehicle booked.

Return a table with one row [destination, count] per destination, where count is the number of vehicles going there, written in decimal. List the destinations in the order they first appear in manifest.

 

Example 1:

Input: manifest = [["van","north"],["bus","south"],["car","north"]]
Output: [["north","2"],["south","1"]]
Explanation: Two vehicles go north, and north appears first.

Example 2:

Input: manifest = [["truck","isle"]]
Output: [["isle","1"]]

Example 3:

Input: manifest = [["car","east"],["van","west"],["bus","west"],["bike","east"],["cab","west"]]
Output: [["east","2"],["west","3"]]

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= manifest.length <= 200
  • manifest[i].length == 2
  • Every string consists of lowercase English letters.
